text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Listen closely, Trainer!
Umamusume can also be categorized into various Sengoku warlord types!

Right in the middle of summer camp, No Reason suddenly started
giving a lecture on Sengoku warlords.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
For instance! The 'Feudal Lord' type—born of noble blood,
elegantly striving for supremacy!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
For instance! The 'Strategist' type—not relying on brute force alone,
but rising through cunning schemes!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
And among them, there are those who,
even without noble lineage or great wisdom...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
There are those who work their way up diligently
from mere foot soldiers to attain great success.
choice_data_list: There are Umamusume like that too...?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Mm. In my assessment, the Umamusume among your peers who might become such a presence is...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: 'Tis thee, Mirako~!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Eeeek... M-Me...?!

Being singled out so suddenly,
the Umamusume jumped in surprise.

—Hishi Miracle.
An Umamusume whose personality and running style are utterly ordinary.

Compared to Tanino Gimlet or Symboli Kris S,
she didn't stand out in the slightest.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: I've had my eye on you for a while now. Thought you'd make a fine running partner.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Well now, Mirako.
Care to aim for the realm alongside me?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Aiming to conquer the realm... what do you mean?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
First up is the final battle of the Classic Triple Crown,
the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
The winner might be me,
or it might just be you, Mirako!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Me?
Even just running in the Kikuka Sho
is already crazy enough, so...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Even if I enter, with my skill level
there's no way I can match up~...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
How could they know? Anyone has a shot at victory!
Right, Trainer?
choice_data_list: You're right, everyone has a chance to win.
Yeah, everyone has a chance to win.

text_block_list.text:
Hishi Miracle is currently in the 2-win class
and has never even entered a graded race. But...
As long as she could enter the race, she had a chance of winning. Of that, there was no doubt.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Mirako, speak honestly. Thou must have it too, hidden deep within thy chest—ambition!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huh... Ah, was there...?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: You want to win a graded race, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Well... as long as it gets me the win...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: You want to win a GⅠ, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
A GⅠ... It doesn't feel real at all,
but if I can really win...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
See?! You have it in you too!!
That boiling ambition crying out,
"I want to be the greatest under the sun!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
S-So that was it...
Now that you mention it, I'm starting to feel that way too...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, then I think I'll try my best
together with No Reason-chan...!

And so, Hishi Miracle awoke.
As if she had been completely reborn—!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Daaaahhhhh!!
Follow after me, Mirako-o-o-o-o!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Eeeeek~, wait up~...!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
A warlord is nothing without strong legs and hips, GRAAAHH!
Here we go, 200 reps!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, I can only do about 12 of them...
*sniffle* *sob*...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Long-distance swimming it is! Let us conquer that isolated island, Mirakooo~!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Gurgle gurgle gurgle... *cough* *gag*...
Bwaaah!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Mirako, you...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
...Thoroughly ordinary, aren't you?
Pushing yourself to the absolute limit, and that's it...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Nah, pushing to my limit...
I can't even give it my all in the first place...

"...A miscalculation. Hishi Miracle didn't wake up
that much after all. Perhaps she won't become someone
who can spur me on, but..."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Very well. Some trees need time to grow.
Even if you cannot compete in running or swimming—"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Let us strive to better ourselves in another arena, shall we?
Sounds good, right, Mirako?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Yeah, as long as it's not exercise, I might be able to keep you company for a bit~.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! Then, Trainer,
make the necessary preparations!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: How will the showdown between Miracle-ko and me turn out?!

No Reason and Hishi Miracle.
What should I have them compete in?
choice_data_list: A Zazen Showdown at the Temple

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Oho, building sandcastles, are we?
Very well, let the siege warfare commence!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Mirako! Build upon this beach the mightiest castle of thine own imagination!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah…… I like playing in the sand, so
maybe this could be a real match.
And so, several hours passed...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
How's this, No Reason-chan?
I built a pretty awesome castle!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, the build isn't half bad, but...
It has one major weakness.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Weakness...?
Wait, by the way, what about No Reason-chan's castle?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
My castle? I have none—not yet.
For I have yet to build one, you see.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Huh...?
Then does that mean I won the match...?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Heh, I wonder about that.
For you see, your castle has a weakness.
And that is—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
It's the fact that "we've already built it." 
Here, look out at the offshore!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huh... The waves are gradually heading this way...?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Yes! High tide approaches shortly!
And as for your castle...
(Ksshhh...!)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, it drifted away~.
What a bummer~!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Mhm, the real battle starts here!
As the tide goes out, scoop up all the sand at once...!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Take that! This is my castle!
You misread the time to make your move, Mirako!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: My arms are completely pumped from scooping up all that sand at once... but the victory is mine!
And so, No Reason, who built her castle overnight, achieved a brilliant victory.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: A zazen meditation match at a temple... Hmph, very well. Come, Mirako, let us have a test of endurance.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Zazen...
Ugh, my legs are gonna go totally numb...
And so, the two secluded themselves in a Zen temple...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Clearing the mind of all distractions...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Fugh... My legs are numb...

I spent some time meditating.
And then—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
That was fine training.
Well then, Mirako, shall we be on our way?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hmm...? My flip-flops are...
a little warm.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Could it be that someone
kept it warm inside their coat for me?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Well, about that, you see...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I thought if we put this under us during zazen,
maybe our legs wouldn't go numb...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Whaaaaaat?! So you were sitting
on it the whole time?! Grrr...

Ever the opportunist, Hishi Miracle.
And thus, the two nurtured their mental fortitude.
